facts.fact: Business Tech Africa reports that fintech REasy and Africa Global Logistics are piloting a service, presented in Douala on 2026-10-01, that lets Cameroonian importers pay Chinese suppliers by converting CFA francs to yuan through Alipay, WeChat Pay and Chinese bank accounts.

systems.platform: REasy payment infrastructure (CFA franc to yuan)
